Change only real articulated running limb/torso motion described below, keep Image1's exact camera, full-canvas scale, head volume, costume and pixel framing. No auto-zoom. Keep animation in place. Hair and robe trail right.
Identity: brown high ponytail/red-gem gold crown/red ribbons; large amber eyes/round chibi face; red-gold fire short robe, ivory cuffs, black trousers, red-black-gold shoes, taiji waist buckle. Anatomical LEFT hand ONE brass bell with red tassel, always on near/camera-facing arm in WEST view. Anatomical RIGHT hand ONE fan of FIVE red/gold talismans, always on far arm. Near left shoulder is the visible shoulder: connect it only to BELL arm, never to fan. Far right fan arm emerges from behind torso as phase requires; no swapping props. Keep same invisible floor and root as Image1; preserve genuine flight and small vertical pelvis bob. Do not anchor lowest foot separately, fit bounding box, change head size or move entire body. Native square >=1024 each edge, one character whole body on genuinely transparent alpha. No ground plane, shadow, text, labels, particles, trails, extra limbs or prop doubles.
